technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong volume spike and new highs, but weak trend confirmation (low ADX), intermediate resistance (below 50-MA), and poor money flow limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: BLDR shows no insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 83 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed retail positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (14/100) with contrarian buy signal, 15x volume spike, and new 20-day highs suggest capitulation bottom setup despite weak technicals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 432.88, rising dollar, flat yield curve), price below both 50-MA and 200-MA, zero fundamental conviction, and imminent CPI event create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
